main.title: Israeli military launches new operation on central Gaza despite ceasefire
main.summary: The military says it is targeting Hamas infrastructure near two refugee camps, while Hamas has accused Israel of violating the truce in place since October 2025.

related.title: Israel begins new military operation in Gaza
related.summary: Israeli tanks advanced in an area of the central Gaza Strip on Wednesday, witnesses said, and the Israeli military said its ​forces were targeting ‌Hamas infrastructure outside the "Yellow Line" that sets the boundary of the part of the enclave controlled by Israel "The IDF launched a precise operation within the Gaza Strip earlier today west of the Yellow Line... to remove a threat posed to IDF troops operating in the Gaza Strip," the military said.

related.summary: Prima volta dal cessate il fuoco. Media Striscia riferiscono di tank nell'area centrale

related.title: Palestinians flee refugee camp as Israel begins operation in central Gaza
related.summary: At least three Palestinians were killed as Israeli forces launched strikes near a refugee camp.

180023748a.topic: Israele lancia nuova operazione militare nel centro di Gaza nonostante la tregua
180023748a.reason: È la prima operazione di terra nel centro della Striscia dall'inizio della tregua di ottobre 2025: Hamas accusa Israele di averla violata e la notizia è ripresa da più testate autorevoli.
